# ScribeCat 0.25.19

### PDF viewer
- Show the complete fitted PDF page inside the text editor instead of clipping the lower part of portrait documents.
- Keep the inline viewer at the same height when switching between single-page and multi-page view.
- Center every multi-page row consistently, including incomplete rows.
- Scale overview thumbnails from the actual available width and height so the viewer uses its space more efficiently.
- Continue paging through the remaining PDF pages when they do not fit in the current overview.
- Make mobile fallback fullscreen use the full dynamic viewport and vertically center the fitted PDF page.
- Preserve the corrected desktop/native fullscreen behavior and black side bars for tall pages.

### Server and Docker
- Release metadata and Compose defaults are updated to 0.25.19.
- Publish the exact multi-architecture server image as `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.19`.
